text:
morgan: Heads-up — I sketched a cooperative-pull protocol for tenant credits to reduce oscillation when capacity shifts between edge pods. Want quick feedback before I turn it into an RFC.

sana: gimme the high level please

morgan: gist: central meter keeps a soft global budget; edges only pull extra credits when they see local headroom + central signoff. Pull amounts smoothed with EWMA to avoid spikes.

liam: Concern — if central is flaky, edges could overpull and cause downstream p99 spikes. fallback strategy?

morgan: fallback = conservative local throttling when central unreachable. also plan short-lived pulls (100-500ms leases) so overshoot window is small.

jamie: how does this interact with abuse signals? if a tenant is abusive we need immediate global revoke, otherwise pulls keep flowing.

morgan: agree — abuse path is orthogonal: central can emit immediate revoke + increment abuse score. edges must honor revoke synchronously (best-effort RPC) and apply local probation. pulls are gated by !revoked.

sana: do we need strict linearizability for the pull/lease ops? that's more expensive.

liam: tradeoff: strict = safer but hurts latency. proposal: eventual consistency for normal operation, but short leases + quick revoke for correctness. hybrid approach.

morgan: pseudo:
```
# edge pull logic (simplified)
if central.headroom > THRESHOLD and not tenant.revoked:
    amount = min(requested, EWMA(local_headroom))
    lease = central.request_lease(amount, ttl=200ms)
    if lease.ok: local.credit += lease.amount
    else: local.throttle()
else:
    local.throttle()
```

ops-bot: [sim-run] 1k tenant sim with EWMA smoothing + 200ms lease -> observed ~8% drop in p99 spikes vs naive pull in staging sim. details: https://staging-ci/results/7423

jamie: nice. next steps: morgan write RFC with protocol message shapes & error modes, liam wire up the sim harness with degraded-central scenarios, sana draft abuse-handshake doc. can we canary on staging tomorrow?

morgan: agreed. i'll open RFC + example proto tonight. timeline: RFC by EOD, sim results by Tue. owners: @morgan, @liam, @sana. :white_check_mark:
